newsVersionExact: OpenAI has a new independent mathematics advisory group.
actualMeaningExact: The group can give and publish advice, but it cannot make OpenAI follow it.
mechanismExact: OpenAI reports a result, the group can advise on its significance and release, and OpenAI still makes the company decision.
familiarExampleExact: An outside expert can mark up a report and publish her concerns; the organisation receiving the advice still decides whether to act.

jargon.plainMeaning: a group that gives recommendations but does not make the company’s decisions

learningConnections.learningPayoff: Practises separating an AI-produced claim from the independent evidence used to verify it.
